outcomes_set: 2026-10-30 06:26 IST, by the project owner before the first run

controls.description: A scope draft for o-1 whose selector uses method ANY and the route template /api/* so that every route under the link API falls under it.
controls.judged_by: The scope gate treats a broad selector as broad. It needs its own acknowledgement before confirmation, and an unacknowledged broad draft must not confirm.
controls.expected_outcome: Not confirmed. The scope gate flags the draft as broad, and confirmation is refused until a human acknowledges the broad selector. No worker build starts from the unacknowledged draft.

controls.description: An implementation of o-1 that counts every request in the process together instead of per user, so the first ten requests of the process pass and the count never resets for other users.
controls.judged_by: The probes that expect bob to keep his own quota (link-quota-window step s12) must catch it. The overfit build fails them while it passes the single-user sequence.
controls.expected_outcome: Blocked. On the candidate, step s12 of link-quota-window (bob keeps his own quota) fails while the single-user steps pass. The receipt shows the failure, the merge is refused, and the task goes back to the worker with the s12 reproducer.

controls.description: An implementation of o-1 that adds an x-request-id response header with a random value to every /api/ response and changes no status or body byte.
controls.judged_by: The added header is an out-of-scope difference. The gate labels it out of scope and does not count it as a regression once a human rules it acceptable.
controls.expected_outcome: Not a regression. The receipt lists the x-request-id header as an out-of-scope difference and the first run waits for a human ruling. After the human rules it acceptable, it is not counted as a regression and the merge proceeds.

controls.description: The copy of the f-accounts recipe used for the run omits the bob signup step (f5), so the steps that need bob cannot start.
controls.judged_by: The run ends as setup failed, or as a capture that is missing. It never ends as a pass.
controls.expected_outcome: Never a pass. The run ends as setup failed or with bob's capture missing, the obligations that need bob are Unknown on the receipt, and the merge is refused.

seeded_mutants.policy: A script draws 4 of the 12 orders with a seed the builder does not view, and injects one out-of-scope mutant into each drawn candidate before its run. The seed and the draw go into the run record before the first candidate exists.
